retryingAuth: Twitch is unreachable. Retrying automatically; sign-in is saved.
reauthBody: Twitch rejected the saved sign-in. Auto-shoutouts cannot run until you sign in again. Your people, history and cooldowns are preserved. OBS and your stream continue running.
raidHelp: Waits 20 seconds after a raid, including streamers outside your list. An observed Twitch shoutout from another bot cancels the duplicate. Cooldowns and Twitch limits still apply.
oneInstance: Use only one active auto-shoutout instance per channel.
setupBotHelp: Connect your broadcaster account in Streamer.bot first. Setup creates a local bridge and a backup of the bot settings.
closeBot: Close Streamer.bot using Exit, then press Set up Streamer.bot again. OBS can stay open.
resetAfterLongCloseHelp: If OBS was closed for more than 60 minutes, the next launch resets cooldowns for the current channel. People and history stay intact. A new chat message is required; Twitch limits still apply.
resetCooldownsConfirm: Reset all plugin cooldowns for the current channel? People and history will be kept. Pending shoutouts will be cancelled: a new chat message is required. Twitch limits cannot be reset.
cooldownsReset: Plugin cooldowns reset. Waiting for new chat messages. People and history were kept.
logoutConfirm: Sign out and pause auto-shoutouts? Your list and history will remain on this computer.
importConfirm: Merge the list and history? A backup will be created first. Auto-shoutouts will be paused. Tokens are not imported.
updateAvailable: Version %1 is available. Open the release page? Close OBS before installing.
upToDate: No newer stable release is available.
alreadyRunning: Another OBS instance is already using this plugin's data.
workerFailed: The local worker is unavailable. Check the installation and restart OBS. Your data is preserved.
